stories.headline: US-Russia-Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi, first trilateral round since February

key_facts.fact: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday, Nov. 10, in Abu Dhabi, the first such meeting since February; the two-day session focuses on future security guarantees.
key_facts.excerpt: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates... The two-day session in the UAE's capital, Abu Dhabi, is the first such meeting since February. It will focus on establishing future security guarantees

key_facts.fact: The US delegation is led by envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; Russia's by Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, with deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin and military intelligence chief Igor Kostyukov; Ukraine's by Foreign Intelligence chief Rustem Umerov.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S.-brokered talks will be attended by envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner... The Kremlin's delegation is led by presidential aide Vladimir Medinsky... deputy foreign ministers, Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, as well as military intelligence chief Igor Kostyukov

key_facts.fact: Kyiv hopes to use the talks to discuss prisoner exchanges and a possible maritime and energy ceasefire, laying groundwork for a leaders' summit.
key_facts.excerpt: Kyiv hopes to use the technical-level talks to discuss prisoner exchanges and a possible maritime and energy ceasefire, while laying the groundwork for a future summit at the leaders' level.

key_facts.fact: A US official said Moscow and Kyiv had privately shown some flexibility on occupied territory, and that security guarantees, possibly a defence commitment modelled on NATO's Article 5, would be central.
key_facts.excerpt: both Moscow and Kyiv had privately shown some flexibility on Ukrainian territory occupied by Russia. Security guarantees for Ukraine would be a central topic... including the possibility of a defence commitment modelled on Article 5

key_facts.fact: Hours before the talks, Russia attacked 10 Ukrainian regions overnight, hitting five major energy substations; at least nine people were killed and 39 injured over the past day.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia attacked 10 Ukrainian regions overnight, hitting five major energy substations... Russian attacks killed at least nine people and injured 39 others across Ukraine over the past day

key_facts.fact: US, European and Ukrainian negotiators met beforehand and issued a statement on a 'strong post-war European security architecture', saying a strong NATO will remain central; EU negotiators are not in the main trilateral format.
key_facts.excerpt: issued a statement expressing their "shared commitment to a strong post-war European security architecture." ... "were clear that a strong NATO will remain central to Euro-Atlantic collective defense."

stories.headline: Brent falls below $90 for first time since August as Trump says Iran war 'effectively over'

key_facts.fact: After meeting Qatar's prime minister at the White House on Monday, Trump said 'Iran militarily is effectively over' and that the conflict will be 'ending fairly soon'.
key_facts.excerpt: "We're seeing momentum toward the end of this conflict. I think it's going to be ending fairly soon," he said at the White House following a meeting with Qatar's prime minister... "Iran militarily is effectively over," Trump told reporters.

key_facts.fact: Brent settled 5.9% lower on Monday at $92.57, then fell below $90 on Tuesday (about $89.92, down 2.9%); WTI fell to about $84.60.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent was down 2.9% at $89.92 as of 5:05 a.m. ET. US crude (WTI) fell 2.6% to $84.60. The drop builds on Monday's slide. Brent settled 5.9% lower that day, at $92.57.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the US will keep its naval blockade in place for now; Iran's Mohsen Rezaei denied talks, telling Washington to 'stop manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks'.
key_facts.excerpt: a naval blockade against the country will remain largely in place... Mohsen Rezaei said in a social media post that Washington should "stop manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks."

key_facts.fact: Wall Street posted its strongest session since April on Monday: S&P 500 +2.4%, Nasdaq 100 +3.4%, Dow +2.2%, as falling oil restored confidence after last week's post-midterm selloff.
key_facts.excerpt: The S&P 500 surged 2.4% to 7,549.94, the Nasdaq 100 jumped 3.4% to 27,907.63, and the Dow gained 2.2%, marking Wall Street's strongest session since April as falling oil prices helped restore confidence

key_facts.fact: Asian markets followed on Tuesday: South Korea's Kospi rose 4.4% and Japan's Nikkei 2.9% to 60,459.
key_facts.excerpt: Tokyo – Nikkei 225: UP 2.9% at 60,459.58 (close); Seoul – Kospi: UP 4.4% at 5,239.13 (close)

key_facts.fact: Traders priced an 82.2% chance of a Fed rate hike in December, versus 74% a week earlier, ahead of October CPI data.
key_facts.excerpt: Traders are pricing in an 82.2 per cent chance of a rate hike next month versus 74 per cent a week earlier, the CME FedWatch tool showed

stories.headline: China's trade surplus tops $1 trillion for second year as October exports jump 35.2%

key_facts.fact: China logged a $1.04 trillion trade surplus in January-October 2026, topping $1 trillion for a second straight year, per customs data released Tuesday, Nov. 10.
key_facts.excerpt: Between January and October, China logged a $1.04 trillion trade surplus

key_facts.fact: October exports rose 35.2% year-on-year to $412.3 billion, above the 33.5% forecast; imports rose 41.6% to $307.1 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Exports jumped 35.2% year-on-year to $412.3 billion last month... while imports expanded 41.6% to $307.1 billion.

key_facts.fact: The monthly surplus narrowed to $105.3 billion in October from $133.5 billion in September as imports picked up.
key_facts.excerpt: the trade surplus narrowed last month to $105.3 billion from $133.5bn in September as imports picked up pace

key_facts.fact: The milestone came faster than ever; the full-year 2025 surplus was a record $1.2 trillion. Exports to the US rose 32.9% in October.
key_facts.excerpt: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion in the first ten months of this year, the fastest it has ever reached that mark... compared with a record $1.2 trillion for the full year 2025... China's exports to the U.S. soared 32.9%

key_facts.fact: Exports have been driven by global demand for AI-related products such as chips, data-centre servers and networking gear, ahead of a Xi-Trump meeting at APEC in China next week.
key_facts.excerpt: driven in part by soaring global demand for artificial intelligence-related products including computer chips, data centre servers and networking equipment... ahead of another high-stakes meeting between President Xi Jinping and US counterpart Donald Trump at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit

stories.headline: FDA approves Bayer's Sunharbo, first Factor XIa blood thinner, for stroke prevention

key_facts.fact: On Nov. 9, the FDA approved Bayer's Sunharbo (asundexian) 50 mg, the first Factor XIa inhibitor, with antiplatelet therapy to reduce stroke risk after a recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk TIA.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Sunharbo (asundexian) 50 mg tablets, the first factor XIa (FXIa) inhibitor for use in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke

key_facts.fact: In the 12,327-patient Phase 3 OCEANIC-STROKE trial, Sunharbo cut ischemic stroke risk by 26% versus placebo over a median 14.2 months.
key_facts.excerpt: enrolled 12,327 adults... Sunharbo 50 mg once daily significantly reduced the risk of ischemic stroke by 26% compared to placebo over a median treatment of 14.2 months.

key_facts.fact: Major bleeding was similar overall but higher in patients over 75 and in the first 90 days; it is not approved for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation.
key_facts.excerpt: The overall rate of major bleeding was similar between the Sunharbo and placebo groups but was increased with Sunharbo in patients older than 75 years and during the first 90 days of treatment... Sunharbo is not approved for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation.

key_facts.fact: Bayer expects shipping to begin in mid-to-late November.
key_facts.excerpt: Bayer anticipates that Sunharbo will begin shipping in mid-to-late November

key_facts.fact: The drug is designed to prevent harmful clots while preserving the body's ability to stop bleeding; more than 795,000 people in the US have a stroke each year.
key_facts.excerpt: Sunharbo is designed to strike a balance between preventing harmful clots and preserving the body's ability to stop dangerous bleeding... more than 795,000 people in the U.S. have a stroke each year

key_facts.fact: The same day, the FDA ordered class-wide GLP-1 label warnings on NAION, a rare condition that can cause sudden vision loss, and rejected Novocure's metastatic cancer application.
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA is requiring class-wide label changes warning that GLP-1 medicines may be associated with non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, or NAION, a rare condition that can cause sudden vision loss... The FDA denied Novocure approval for its metastatic cancer treatment.

stories.headline: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for sabotage hack of 700 supermarkets' fridges

key_facts.fact: On Monday, Nov. 9, France blamed Iran for the October cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators, summoned the Iranian ambassador and said it would seek European sanctions.
key_facts.excerpt: France on Monday blamed Iran for last month's cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators, summoned the Iranian ambassador and said it would seek European sanctions

key_facts.fact: Paris prosecutors attributed the attack to 'Shahid Kaveh', an offensive cyber unit of the IRGC's Electronic and Cyber Center, opened an investigation into its leader and two deputies, and requested international arrest warrants for two officials.
key_facts.excerpt: Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau said Monday she had opened an investigation into Shahid Kaveh... The prosecutor's office has requested international arrest warrants for two Shahid Kaveh officials.

key_facts.fact: The Oct. 11-12 attack hit about 700 retail locations, causing major food spoilage and around 20 fires; attackers triggered indefinite defrost cycles while disabling safety alerts.
key_facts.excerpt: hitting "700 retail locations across France,"... caused "significant food spoilage and triggered roughly twenty fires"... initiating indefinite, abnormal defrost cycles while simultaneously disabling safety alerts

key_facts.fact: The attack targeted remote-management software from Danish firm Danfoss; chains hit included Coopérative U, Intermarché, Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc, with some fridges reaching 50C.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 100 of Coopérative U's supermarkets were hit, as well as 180 stores from Intermarché... Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc were also hit by the attack, which targeted software provided by Danish engineering firm Danfoss.

key_facts.fact: Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot called it France's first large-scale sabotage cyberattack on national territory and said Tuesday France 'rules nothing out' in its response.
key_facts.excerpt: On Tuesday, France's foreign minister said the country "rules nothing out" in its response to what he called "a terrorist organization that has committed an attack of unprecedented scale and aggression against our country."

key_facts.fact: French intelligence linked the unit to hacktivist personas CyberAveng3rs and Soldiers of Solomon; the same operation also targeted small French hydroelectric facilities with limited effect.
key_facts.excerpt: The same operation also targeted equipment at small hydroelectric facilities in France, with limited effects... French intelligence linked Shahid Kaveh to several online hacktivist personas, including CyberAveng3rs and Soldiers of Solomon

stories.headline: California voters reject Prop 40 billionaire wealth tax, 52.8% to 47.2%

key_facts.fact: AP projected on Monday, Nov. 9, that California voters rejected Proposition 40, a one-time 5% tax on residents and trusts worth over $1 billion, by 52.8% to 47.2%.
key_facts.excerpt: Voters rejected Proposition 40, a proposal to tax billionaires based on their net worth and financial holdings, by 52.8% to 47.2%, according to The Associated Press Monday.

key_facts.fact: Backers said the tax would raise about $100 billion over five years, mostly for healthcare after federal cuts, and would have affected roughly 200 billionaires.
key_facts.excerpt: Yes on 40, the main group backing the measure, had said the tax would generate around $100 billion over five years. The measure would have affected roughly 200 of California's billionaires.

key_facts.fact: Billionaire opponents donated $378.4 million to defeat it; Google co-founder Sergey Brin gave $102 million to Building a Better California.
key_facts.excerpt: Collectively, ultra-wealthy opponents donated $378.4 million to oppose the billionaire tax... Sergey Brin led the charge, publicly moving out of state and donating $102 million to Building a Better California

key_facts.fact: Gov. Gavin Newsom and Gov.-elect Xavier Becerra opposed the measure; Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Ro Khanna backed it, and SEIU called the result 'only round one'.
key_facts.excerpt: Democratic opponents included outgoing Gov. Gavin Newsom... and Gov.-elect Xavier Becerra... Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., and Rep. Ro Khanna, D-Calif.... were among its notable backers... "this is only round one"

key_facts.fact: In late October, opponents were outspending supporters 250 to 1 on ads, according to AdImpact.
key_facts.excerpt: In late October, they were outspending supporters 250 to 1 on ads, according to the ad-tracking firm AdImpact.

stories.headline: Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital commits $150M loan to Rocket Lab for Neutron rocket

key_facts.fact: On Nov. 9, the Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Rocket Lab USA to raise the flight rate of its reusable Neutron rocket.
key_facts.excerpt: The Office of Strategic Capital (OSC) announced today a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Rocket Lab USA, Inc.... The loan would support Rocket Lab's efforts to increase the flight rate of its reusable Neutron rocket beyond first launch

key_facts.fact: The money would fund faster vehicle delivery, more recovery and transport vessels, increased engine and composite-structure production, and infrastructure to cut turnaround between launches.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed loan would support faster vehicle delivery and processing and allow Rocket Lab to expand its fleet of maritime vessels... enable manufacturing upgrades to increase the production of composite structures and engines

key_facts.fact: Neutron is designed to carry about 13,000 kg to low Earth orbit, giving the US government a new medium-lift launch option.
key_facts.excerpt: Rocket Lab's Neutron rocket is a reusable launch vehicle designed to deliver payloads of approximately 13,000 kg to Low Earth Orbit

key_facts.fact: Rocket Lab must meet financial, legal, technical and due-diligence requirements before financial close; Neutron's Stage 2 and thrust module arrived at its Wallops Island, Virginia, factory in October.
key_facts.excerpt: A $150 million government loan would support production and recovery infrastructure for the reusable rocket... Neutron's Stage 2 and Thrust Module arrived at the company's factory in Wallops Island, Virginia, in October 2026.

key_facts.fact: The loan comes nearly three months after the Space Force named Rocket Lab among five firms sharing $12 million to prototype links to the Space Data Network Backbone.
key_facts.excerpt: News of the loan comes nearly three months after the Space Force announced a $12 million loan to Rocket Lab, among four other companies, to prototype and demonstrate ways to connect to the Space Data network Backbone.
